input_rule: Renders come only from the on-disk GLB; receipt input_sha256 is the GLB sha256.

turntable.azimuth: glTF Y-up; azimuth 0 = +Z, increasing toward +X seen clockwise from above; Blender (x,y,z)=(x,-z,y)
turntable.distance: D = 1.2*R/tan(FOV/2), R = half diagonal of the visible-mesh AABB, target = AABB centre

checks.rerender_seed: frame index = first 8 hex of input_sha256 mod frames + 1
